changed (correct it): "The CLI executor matrix now records who ran each dispatch." (CLI Dispatch intro) — ORIGINAL scopes executor-identity recording to non-native dispatches ("Non-native dispatches carry executor identity from their first record") and explicitly says "Native runs are unchanged"; the intro widens the scope to every dispatch.

added (remove it): "Evidence-marker parsing and readiness docs now match how the tools behave." — ORIGINAL states only that fence parsing avoids false-positive warnings (with mismatched/unclosed fences remaining separate false-negative cases) and that readiness docs distinguish emitted trust states from compatibility vocabulary; it never states that evidence-marker parsing matches how the tools behave.

added (remove it): "## How It Was Checked / Tests and scenarios" presents "The 30-iteration research found 29 of 86 packet-level `description.json` files in the `026` tree.
